contracts.name: shortenWithMarker
contracts.signature: function shortenWithMarker(text: string, limit: number, marker: string): string

preconditions: Text arguments contain at most 64 Unicode code points each and no lone surrogate code units. Indices and lengths count code points, not UTF-16 units. Inputs are unchanged; returned arrays are fresh. Limit is an integer from 0 through 64 and marker length is at most limit.
